current_translation: to assemble, to meet; meeting; association, group
proposed_translation: can; to know how to; will, be likely to; meeting
note: The main HSK 1 sense, "can / know how to / will", is missing, and the gloss puts "to assemble" first.

current_translation: mark, sign; symbol; number; to call, to cry, to roar
proposed_translation: day of the month (date); number; size; mark, sign
note: The HSK 1 sense "day of the month" is missing. Also, "to call, to cry, to roar" belongs to the háo reading (号叫), not hào.

current_translation: wool; interrogative or emphatic final particle
proposed_translation: question particle (and you?; what about...?); particle for ongoing action
note: As an HSK 1 particle, 呢 is read in the neutral tone (ne), not né. The "wool" sense belongs to the reading ní (呢子) and shouldn't come first.

proposed_translation: and; with; together with; peace; harmony
note: The HSK 1 meaning "and; with" is missing, and the translation leads with the literary sense "harmony".
哪儿 is an erhua word and its standard pinyin is nǎr, not a separate syllable "nǎ er".

proposed_translation: hot; heat; to heat up; fever
note: The main HSK 1 sense, the adjective "hot", is missing, so a learner who answers "hot" could be marked wrong.

current_translation: unit of distance equal to 0.5km; village; lane
note: The HSK 1 sense "inside" is missing, and the listed senses (a unit of distance, village, lane) are secondary or archaic.
kwukyel is a romanized Korean term (gugyeol, a Korean annotation script), not an English meaning, so it tells the learner nothing.
On its own, 卜 is read bǔ ("divination"); the toneless "bo" is only the neutral-tone reading in 萝卜 luóbo, so it's wrong to teach it for the character alone.

current_translation: to divine; to observe; to versify
proposed_translation: to occupy; to take up; to account for
note: The glosses belong to the zhān reading ("to divine"), and "to versify" is archaic. They don't match the stored zhàn reading, whose main modern meaning is "to occupy".
The meaning "only, merely, just" belongs to the reading zhǐ. The stored reading zhī is the measure word for animals and one of a pair.

current_translation: arid, dry; to oppose; to offend; to invade
note: The pinyin is gàn ("to do"), but the glosses belong to the gān reading ("dry"), and "to oppose / offend / invade" are archaic senses.
alone isn't a normal modern meaning of 一, so the answer key would accept a wrong answer; "single" fits better.
The pinyin writes the erhua 儿 as a separate syllable "er". The standard form is yīdiǎnr, with the r attached to the syllable before it.

current_translation: below, underneath; inferior; to bring down; next
proposed_translation: down; below, under; next; to go down, get off; to fall (rain, snow)
note: The translation leaves out the basic HSK 1 senses "down", "to go down / get off" and "to fall" (as in 下雨), and it gives "inferior" and "to bring down", which are secondary or odd senses.

current_translation: this, that; single; measure word for individuals
proposed_translation: measure word for people or objects; general classifier; individual
note: The first sense, "this, that", is wrong for standalone 个 in modern Mandarin (that meaning comes from 这/那), and it would let "this" or "that" pass as a correct answer.

current_translation: to buy, to purchase; to bribe, to persuade
note: On its own, 买 doesn't mean "to bribe" or "to persuade" in modern use (bribing is 收买 or 买通), so these extra answers would wrongly be accepted.

current_translation: clear; to finish; particle of completed action
proposed_translation: particle of completed action; particle of change of state
note: clear and "to finish" belong to the liǎo reading, not le, but they come first and are accepted as answers, which hides the HSK 1 particle meaning.
On its own, 二 doesn't mean "twice" (that's 两次), so that alternative should be removed; the reading èr is correct.
surname is a stray alternative that lets a wrong answer pass, and it's a noisy prompt on writing cards.

proposed_translation: some; a few; several; a little (more)
note: The translation leaves out the main HSK 1 sense, "some" (as in 一些, 这些, 那些), and leads with "little, few".
On its own, 什么 doesn't mean "who" (that's 谁; 什么 only gets that sense in 什么人), so "who" is a confusing writing prompt and lets wrong answers pass.
The main HSK 1 sense "he/him" is buried behind the literary "other", and "she, it" are wrong in modern Mandarin because those are 她 and 它.

current_translation: to reside, to live at, to dwell, to lodge; to stop
proposed_translation: to live; to reside; to stay; to dwell
note: To stop is a real sense of 住, but mostly as a verb complement (住手, 停住), so it lets "stop" pass as a standalone answer and points learners to 停 on writing cards; the common sense "to stay" is also missing.

current_translation: to work, to make; to act
proposed_translation: to do; to make; to cook; to act as
note: The translation leaves out "to do", the main HSK 1 sense, and puts "to work" first, which points learners toward 工作.
All around, all sides isn't a meaning of 八 on its own. It only comes from set phrases like 四面八方, so it shouldn't be accepted as an answer.

current_translation: to write; to draw, to sketch; to compose
note: The "draw, sketch" sense only really shows up in words like 写生. Keeping it would let a learner answer "draw" (画) and still be marked correct.
lonely isn't a standard meaning of 冷 on its own; "deserted" comes from compounds like 冷清, and "lonely" belongs to 孤单 or 寂寞. "cool" fits 凉 better, so both let wrong answers pass.

current_translation: small table; how many; a few, some
note: Small table belongs to the jī reading (as in 茶几), so it doesn't fit jǐ, and it shouldn't be listed first for the HSK 1 sense "how many".
Complete and "perfect" aren't modern meanings of 十 on its own; they only appear in set phrases like 十全十美 (perfect in every way). Leaving them in lets wrong answers pass.

current_translation: to go away, to leave, to depart
proposed_translation: to go; to go to (a place); to leave
note: The translation leaves out the main HSK 1 sense "to go (to a place)" and starts with "go away / depart", which is misleading.

current_translation: cry, shout; to call, to greet, to hail
proposed_translation: to be called (named); to call; to shout; to ask (sb to do sth)
note: The translation leaves out the core HSK 1 sense "to be called/named" (as in 我叫…), and it opens with "cry" instead.

current_translation: to eat; to drink; to suffer, to endure, to bear
proposed_translation: to eat; to have a meal; to suffer, to endure
note: to drink as the second listed sense is misleading, because 喝 is the HSK 1 word for "drink," and it lets a learner who confuses 吃 with 喝 get marked correct.

current_translation: to hear, to listen; to understand; to obey
proposed_translation: to listen; to hear; to obey
note: On its own, 听 doesn't mean "to understand" (that sense comes from 听懂 or 懂), so this alternative would let learners mix it up with 懂 and still be graded correct.

The alternatives are separated by question marks, not commas or semicolons, so the grader may treat them as one string and reject a plain "which". The rhetorical sense "how?" (as in 哪能) is marginal for HSK 1.
The gloss leaves out "hello (on the phone)", which is the HSK 1 sense, so a learner who answers "hello" would likely be marked wrong.

current_translation: to drink; to shout, to call out
note: The "shout / call out" meaning belongs to the reading hè (as in 喝彩 and 喝令), not hē, and on writing cards it could lead learners toward 喊 or 叫; for HSK 1 the meaning should be "to drink".

current_translation: seat; to sit; to ride, to travel by
proposed_translation: to sit; to take a seat; to take (a bus, plane, etc.); to travel by
note: In modern Chinese, the noun "seat" is written 座, not 坐, so it shouldn't be listed first or accepted as an answer.
In the 'how much/how many' sense, Xiandai Hanyu Cidian and the HSK list read it duōshao with a neutral-tone 少; duōshǎo is the 'more or less' sense.
The alternatives "high" and "deep" would accept answers that belong to 高 and 深, and neither is a core HSK 1 sense of 大.
big is a literary sense of 太 (as in 太空), not a modern standalone meaning, and accepting it lets learners mix 太 up with 大.
Harvest is an archaic literary sense that shouldn't count as a correct answer, and the HSK 1 sense "years old" should come first.
Construction isn't a modern meaning of 工作 (that's 施工/工程), and the common verb sense "to work" is missing.

current_translation: to open; to start, to initiate, to begin
proposed_translation: to open; to turn on; to drive; to start
note: The translation leaves out two common senses: "to turn on" (from the HSK gloss) and "to drive". A learner who answers with either one would be marked wrong.

current_translation: to believe, to wish for; to consider, to plan, to think
proposed_translation: to want to; to think; would like to; to miss
note: The gloss leaves out the core HSK 1 senses "to want to / would like to" and "to miss", and it opens with the weaker sense "to believe".
The alternatives "our, us" are HSK 1 meanings of 我们, so they blur the two words on writing cards and let the wrong meaning pass.

current_translation: to have, to own, to possess; to exist
proposed_translation: to have; there is; there are; to exist; to own
note: The translation leaves out the core existential sense "there is / there are", so a learner who answers that would be marked wrong.

proposed_translation: measure word for books; volume; root, origin; basis
note: For HSK 1, 本 is taught as the measure word for books (一本书), and the translation doesn't include that sense.

current_translation: to arrive, to come, to return; in the future, later on
proposed_translation: to come; to arrive; ever since; next, coming
note: 来 on its own doesn't mean "to return", so that alternative accepts a wrong answer; "to come" should be listed first.
Lotion and "juice" are marginal senses that tie 水 to juice (果汁) and would pass wrong answers.

proposed_translation: o'clock; a little, a bit; dot, point; to order (food)
note: The translation leaves out the main HSK 1 senses, "o'clock" and "a little", and gives only the dot/speck meanings.

current_translation: aim, goal; of; possessive particle; -self suffix
note: aim, goal belongs to the dì reading (as in 目的), which doesn't fit the stored reading "de", and "-self suffix" is simply wrong.

current_translation: can, may; capable, full of energy
proposed_translation: can; to be able to; capable; ability; may
note: Full of energy isn't a meaning of 能 in modern Chinese (it means energy only in 能量), and the key HSK senses "to be able to" and "ability" are missing.
The alternative "order" is not a meaning of 菜, but the grader would still accept it, and the main sense "dish" should come first.

current_translation: to study, to learn; to read, to pronounce
proposed_translation: to read; to read aloud; to study; to pronounce
note: The main HSK 1 sense, "to read", comes after "to study, to learn", so on writing cards learners are likely to type 学 instead.
Both the HSK list and Xiandai Hanyu Cidian give shéi as the standard reading and shuí only as a variant, so learners who answer shéi would be marked wrong.
On its own, 这 doesn't mean "here" (that's 这儿/这里), so the "here" alternative accepts a wrong answer and blurs 这 with 这儿.

current_translation: all, each, entirely, whole; metropolis; capital
note: Metropolis; capital belong to the dū reading, not dōu, and the key HSK 1 sense "both" is missing.

current_translation: male adult; robust, vigorous; 4th heavenly stem
proposed_translation: fourth (in a series); small cube (of food); person; member of a household
note: Robust, vigorous is an archaic sense, and the gloss leaves out the common modern meanings "fourth" and "small cube" (as in 肉丁, diced meat).

current_translation: moreover, also (post-subject); about to, will soon (pre-verb)
proposed_translation: moreover; and also; for the time being; even
note: About to, will soon is a classical sense, and the grammar notes in parentheses make the prompt cluttered.
丨 is the vertical-stroke radical. "Number one" is the meaning of 一, so it doesn't belong here and would accept a wrong answer.

current_translation: central; center, middle; amidst; to hit (target), to attain; China; Chinese
note: To hit (target), to attain belongs to the zhòng reading, so it doesn't match the stored reading zhōng.

current_translation: to own; to host; master; host; lord
note: The gloss leaves out the key modern sense "main/primary" (as in 主要), and it leads with "to own", which isn't a standard verb sense of 主.

current_translation: secret, hidden, mysterious; small, minute; to conceal
note: The gloss uses the obscure Unihan sense (乚 read yǐn, meaning 隐 "hidden"). As a component, 乚 is the hook-shaped variant of 乙.
To say, to speak is a literary/classical sense found only in set phrases like 人云亦云, so it's a poor answer key and prompt for beginners; the modern meaning is "cloud".
Mixed, miscellaneous belongs to the shí reading (as in 什锦), not shén, so it doesn't fit the stored reading or 什么.

current_translation: command, decree, order; magistrate; to allow, to cause
proposed_translation: to make, to cause; order, command; decree
note: Magistrate is an archaic sense, and "to allow" doesn't fit modern usage. Both would let wrong answers pass, and the main modern sense "to make/cause" should come first.

current_translation: to wait, to expect; to visit; to greet
proposed_translation: to wait; time; season; to inquire after (someone)
note: The gloss leaves out the "time / season" sense, which is the meaning 候 has in 时候 (and 气候). "To visit" and "to expect" are uncommon or archaic senses.

proposed_translation: yuan (unit of money); dollar; first; primary
note: The gloss leaves out the main modern sense, yuan as the unit of money, and includes "head", an archaic sense that would let wrong answers pass.

proposed_translation: to exchange; to convert (currency); to cash (a check)
note: On their own, "cash" and "check" read as nouns, or "check" as in "inspect", when 兑 actually means "to exchange" or "to cash".

current_translation: frontier pass; to close, to shut; relation
proposed_translation: to close; to shut; to turn off; relation; pass (mountain pass)
note: The gloss starts with "frontier pass", a sense learners rarely need, while the everyday meanings "close" and "turn off" and the sense used in 没关系 ("relation") come later or are missing.

current_translation: to thrive, to prosper, to flourish
note: The meaning "thrive/prosper" belongs to the xīng reading, but 兴 in 高兴 is read xìng, which means "interest/mood", so the pinyin and translation don't match.
The glosses "tender" and "weak" are archaic. Today 冉 is mostly a surname or appears in 冉冉, meaning "slowly or gradually".
Hot is not a standard sense of 冏, and "bright/brilliant" is a literary sense. In modern use the character mostly appears as the 囧 "awkward, embarrassed" meme.
The gloss leaves out the main modern sense, "fierce/ferocious". It also includes "sad", which 凶 doesn't mean, and "culprit", which only fits as part of 凶手 (murderer).

current_translation: to go out, to send out; stand; produce
proposed_translation: to go out; to come out; to send out; to produce
note: stand isn't a normal modern meaning of 出 on its own, so it misleads learners and lets wrong answers be marked correct.
Old coin is archaic and "measure" is too vague, so both let wrong answers pass; the main meaning is knife.

current_translation: to divide, to allocate; fraction; small unit of time or other quantity
proposed_translation: minute; to divide; point (score); cent; fraction
note: The gloss leaves out "minute", which is the meaning 分钟 relies on, and "small unit of time" is too vague to accept "minute" as an answer.
The main modern sense of 卓, "outstanding/eminent" (as in 卓越), is missing, and "profound" is not an accurate meaning.
Cliff is the radical meaning, which belongs to the hàn reading, not chǎng. It shouldn't come first, and neither "cliff" nor the vague "building" should be accepted as answers.

proposed_translation: sentence; clause; phrase; line (of verse); measure word for sentences
note: paragraph is wrong (that's 段), and "stanza" is inaccurate (句 means a line of verse), so wrong answers would be accepted.

current_translation: I, my, our; to resist, to impede
note: The sense "to resist, to impede" is archaic, since in classical texts 吾 stood in for 御, and it would let wrong answers pass.
Slanted is an obscure, non-modern sense that would accept wrong answers.
The translation leaves out "day", which is the sense 天 has in 今天, 明天 and 昨天, and "god, celestial" is a marginal sense.

The reading guài is correct, but the character is almost never used on its own in modern Chinese; "decisive" (the I Ching hexagram sense) is the only standard gloss, while "parted" and "fork" are obscure or doubtful.

current_translation: son, child; seed, egg; fruit; small thing
proposed_translation: child; son; seed; noun suffix (as in 桌子)
note: On its own, 子 is read zǐ. Neutral-tone "zi" is only its reading as the noun suffix, which is the role it plays in these HSK 1 words but is missing from the translation, and "fruit" and "egg" are marginal senses.

proposed_translation: to long for; to cling to; noun suffix (as in 尾巴, 嘴巴); bus (as in 巴士)
note: The gloss gives only the narrow sense "to wish for" (as in 巴望) and leaves out the more common uses: "to cling to" and the noun suffix in 嘴巴 and 尾巴.
building, house is the meaning of the radical 广 read yǎn, not of guǎng, so it shouldn't count as a correct answer here.

current_translation: to execute; to grasp, to hold; to keep; to sieze, to detain
proposed_translation: to hold; to grasp; to carry out; to persist in
note: The first sense, "to execute", could be read as putting someone to death, "sieze" is misspelled, and "to detain" is archaic, so the main sense "to hold" should come first.

current_translation: to rap, to tap; script; to let go
proposed_translation: to tap; to rap; to strike (tapping hand radical)
note: The glosses "script" and "to let go" are wrong for 攵, a form of 攴 meaning to tap or strike, and they would let wrong answers be marked correct.

proposed_translation: reason; cause; incident; old, former; therefore
note: happening, instance is an odd gloss, and the translation leaves out the common senses "old/former" and "therefore".

current_translation: a catty (about 500 grams); an axe; keen, shrewd
proposed_translation: jin (unit of weight, 500 grams); catty; half a kilogram
note: The glosses "axe" and "keen, shrewd" are archaic or obscure, so they would let wrong answers pass; the modern meaning is only the weight unit.
Desk is not a modern meaning of 机, but it is listed first. It would also let a wrong answer pass. The key sense is "machine/airplane" (as in 飞机).

current_translation: to lack, to owe; to breathe, to yawn
proposed_translation: to owe; to lack; to yawn
note: To breathe isn't a modern meaning of 欠 (it comes from the old sense of the radical), so it would let a wrong answer pass.

current_translation: not, none, gone; to bury; to sink, to drown
proposed_translation: not; have not; did not; without
note: The senses "to bury; to sink, to drown" belong to the mò reading, not méi, so they don't fit the stored pinyin and would let wrong answers pass.

current_translation: to drift, to float; to be tossed about; bleach
note: The meanings 'float/drift' (piāo) and 'bleach' (piǎo) don't match the stored reading piào, which is only used in 漂亮 ('pretty').

current_translation: eye; to look, to see; division, topic
note: Using 目 as the verb "to look, to see" is literary, not modern, so an answer of "see" would be marked correct; "item/list" are the common modern senses.
Equal isn't a meaning of 相 on its own (that comes from 相等), so it shouldn't be accepted as an answer; the other meanings and the reading xiāng are fine.

current_translation: altar; ceremony; to show, to demonstrate
proposed_translation: to show; to indicate; to demonstrate
note: Altar and "ceremony" are old radical meanings, not modern ones, and they come before the main modern sense, "to show".
Duckweed and "Artemisia" are old or botanical senses that don't matter for 苹果, and they clutter the prompt and the answer key.
覀 is the top form of the "cover" radical 襾, as in 要 and 票. It is not the character 西, so the glosses "west, western, westward" are misleading.

current_translation: conscious; to nap, to sleep; to wake up
second_opinion: disputes (auditor): 觉 is jué as a character; jiào only in 睡觉
note: This item is only here because of 睡觉 (shuìjiào), where 觉 is read jiào and means "sleep", but the stored reading is jué and the meanings mix senses from both readings.

current_translation: to walk, to run, to flee
proposed_translation: to walk; to go; to leave
note: To run is a classical sense of 走; in modern Mandarin "run" is 跑, and "to flee" is also not a standalone modern meaning. The gloss is also missing the key senses "go" and "leave".
Pregnancy is a literary sense (as in 有身) that a learner wouldn't be expected to know, and "person" is a loose gloss. The more useful everyday sense, "oneself/personally", is missing.

current_translation: cart, vehicle; to move in a cart
note: The gloss leaves out "car", the main modern sense and the one used in 出租车, and it includes an archaic sense, "to move in a cart".

current_translation: nature's color; blue, green, black; young
note: The first sense, "nature's color", is a vague dictionary gloss, not a real meaning, and "black" is a rare, literary sense that could let a wrong answer pass.
high isn't a standard meaning of 飞 on its own, so a wrong answer like "tall" could be marked correct.
The "surname" alternative would accept a vague wrong answer, so keep only "horse".
